mentions.name: DIY Golf Launch Monitor
mentions.description: A DIY golf launch monitor for indoor practice and sim golf that works without an actual golf ball and lets players use their own clubs. It uses an ESP32, a high-speed ADC, and four bass guitar pickups to detect and reverse engineer the club's path and face angle as it swings past the pickups.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A golf launch monitor that lets you practice and play sim golf inside. Doesn't require an actual golf ball and lets you use your own clubs.

Using an esp32, high speed ADC and 4 bass guitar pickups to detect and reverse engineer the club's path and face angle as it swings past the pickups.
